scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Archive closed physical-reference fields, qualifications and diagnostics without accepting physical convergence.
pending_work_excluded_from_successful_ev: Fine physical native four-model fields and their fresh independent audits.

limitations: Sixteen additional CPU/CUDA cases retain both algorithms, original self-balanced source-prior/cone/scatter/full-field/gauge gates and pair-union per-source wrenches with different destination friction. This is scoped to the selected existing balanced_compression and two pair-union fixtures, not every parametrized source-prior case. Fixture assets are explicitly retrospective exact base-revision reconstructions, not pre-test copies. Numerical acceptance does not establish fine physical/model/convergence/warmed-cost acceptance. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
